name: Lisa: The Pointless - Velvet Collection
summary:
A polished, up to date collection of LISA: The Pointless mods like Scholar of the Wilbur Sin, Infinity Unfolds, SOTWS+ and Nerds and Losers.

The main goal of this fangame expansion is to create a unified experience for most major LISA: The Pointless expansions. Some original content may also be present. and to be a love letter to the original fangame (Before MU Update at the time of this fangame release).
